needed.suggestion: Install dropped kerbs at the marked pedestrian crossing to improve accessibility for wheelchair users and those with mobility aids.
Add a proper pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the marked crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when traffic is heavy.
Install additional street lighting along the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during the cloudy conditions shown.
